description: This file defines a Database class for managing IndexedDB storage, including opening, deleting, retrieving, and saving payloads, with error handling and alert messaging.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: A class for managing IndexedDB operations such as opening, deleting, retrieving, and saving payloads, with error handling and alert messaging.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the database instance, clearing alertService and db references.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Relinquishes the lock to allow database operations to proceed.

methods.name: getAllDatabaseNames
methods.description: Retrieves all database names from IndexedDB.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes multiple databases by name, clearing payloads and deinitializing.

methods.name: openDatabase
methods.description: Opens or creates the IndexedDB database, handling upgrades and version changes.

methods.name: getAllPayloads
methods.description: Retrieves all payload objects stored in the database.

methods.name: getPayloadsForKeys
methods.description: Retrieves payloads for specific keys (currently unused but implemented).

methods.name: getAllKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys from the database.

methods.name: putItems
methods.description: Helper to insert or update items in object store.

methods.name: showAlert
methods.description: Displays an alert message via AlertService or window alert.

methods.name: showGenericError
methods.description: Displays a generic error message for database errors.

methods.name: displayOfflineAlert
methods.description: Displays an offline database error message.
